normalization: NFD; remove combining marks; lowercase; v→u, j→i, æ→ae, œ→oe, ſ→s; lookup only

source.title: LatinCy lexicon / Whitaker's WORDS morphological lookup
source.policy: Candidate analyses must round-trip through the generated paradigm; duplicate DCC keys are filtered by part of speech. Explicit dictionary participle relations and complete printed DCC headword forms may resolve missing citation forms. Single mappings require one morphological lemma and one DCC entry. Ambiguous sets are offered only when every analyzed lemma has a DCC entry and must be displayed as possibilities together. Other ambiguous and unrecognized forms omitted. No contextual disambiguation; no inferred transcription.
